native_test_entries: test1: {'time': 'initial', 'state': {'led1': 'off', 'led2': 'off', 'led3': 'off', 'bargraph1': 'all segments off'}, 'description': 'Initialization phase. All LEDs and bar graph segments are off when the system starts or resets.'}

test2: {'time': 'after 0.5 seconds from test1', 'state': {'led1': 'on', 'led2': 'off', 'led3': 'off', 'bargraph1': 'segment 1 on (binary 001)'}, 'description': 'After pressing btn1 once. LED1 turns on, representing binary bit 0 = 1. Bar graph lights segment 1 (decimal 1).'}

test3: {'time': 'after 0.5 seconds from test2', 'state': {'led1': 'on', 'led2': 'on', 'led3': 'off', 'bargraph1': 'segment 3 on (binary 011)'}, 'description': 'After pressing btn2 once. LED2 turns on, representing binary bit 1 = 1. Bar graph lights segment 3 (decimal 3).'}

test4: {'time': 'after 0.5 seconds from test3', 'state': {'led1': 'on', 'led2': 'on', 'led3': 'on', 'bargraph1': 'segment 7 on (binary 111)'}, 'description': 'After pressing btn3 once. LED3 turns on, representing binary bit 2 = 1. Bar graph lights segment 7 (decimal 7).'}
assumptions: Convert numeric test time to milliseconds; apply changed controls 400ms before observation unless explicit hold duration exists.
Normalized potentiometer positions0..1 map to ADC0..1023.
Every inferred button press is released after200ms unless an explicit hold duration is supplied.
Reference preflight required; no claim that reference consistency proves all prose requirements.
